messages:
sarah (CEO): quick post-all-hands note on the reorg + headcount plan. i'll keep this short and operational. timeline + gating rules below, ask clarifying q's.
dave (CTO): TL;DR: two-phase gating for hires next two quarters. Phase 1 (now): Serving/runtime, Dedicated infra, and customer-facing reliability work. Phase 2 (later in Q2): product growth and non-critical projects.
jen (Recruiting): to confirm 1: new reqs must include a one-line business impact and a "priority-bucket" tag. we'll reject incomplete reqs at intake.
maria (People Ops): internal moves prioritized. post in #internal-moves and add "internal-transfer" to the ticket. we'll do faster approvals for transfers.
leo (VP Eng): small operational change: backfills that keep runway for high-impact projects auto-approve if they map to a prioritized team. non-mapped backfills go through review.
nana (Dir Product): typo in participants? (ana here)
nana (Dir Product): will product hires be starved? how do PMs argue for priority?
sarah (CEO): good Q. PMs should attach a one-paragraph impact statement (metrics impacted + timeline) to the prioritization ticket. customer-facing retention/SLAs get high weight.
jen (Recruiting): interview loop updates: expect fewer interviewers for infra roles to speed decisions. recruiters will push updated loops to hiring managers tomorrow.
tom (Eng): are we changing leveling for new roles? some JDs show older bands.
maria (People Ops): leveling calibration session scheduled Thu 2pm; hiring managers must attend or pre-submit leveling notes.
dave (CTO): hiring mix guidance: prioritize senior ICs for architecture work; mid-level for execution; junior hires allowed where a clear mentoring plan exists.
leo (VP Eng): re org structure: we'll collapse two small infra squads into "Serving Core" and "Ops Platform". no mass reassignments; a handful of TLs will swap to better align skills.
sarah (CEO): timeline: org map published by Fri, role-to-team mapping done in 2 weeks, hiring triage begins immediately.
jen (Recruiting): candidate pipelines continue. if a posted role is deprioritized we'll notify candidates and pause new interviews.
maria (People Ops): headcount visibility: read-only spreadsheet (link: internal/headcount/2026-q2-buckets) will be live by EOD Wed.
nana (Dir Product): is there a fast-track for hires tied to invoices/contracts?
jen (Recruiting): yes 1 tag ticket "urgent-customer" and include the contract/invoice number. that moves it to top of triage.
tom (Eng): sponsorship/relocation implications?
maria (People Ops): existing offers unaffected. new sponsor reqs evaluated per-region; flag on ticket.
sarah (CEO): we're avoiding a hiring freeze; this is prioritization to ensure runway and focus on inference/product reliability. we'll host an AMA next week if folks want a live follow-up. :thumbsup: 
oncall-bot: all-hands notes uploaded: internal/allhands/2026-03-25-summary.md
